Terms of use

A little clarity.

Updated 8 November 2026

Pupwell is independently developed and operated by an individual under the Pupwell name. Contact hello@trypupwell.app.

About Pupwell

Pupwell helps you keep personal routines, focus, reflect in written or voice journals and optionally connect with a person you choose. This website introduces the app and does not take payments or create a subscription.

Everyday wellbeing

Pupwell is designed for personal routines, focus and reflection. It is not medical care, therapy, diagnosis or emergency support, and does not guarantee a health or productivity result.

Your content

Your journal entries and voice recordings belong to you. You choose whether to export or share them. Connected features must not be used for harassment, unlawful content or infringement of another person's rights.

Local storage

Personal app history and recordings are stored locally in the current app. Losing a device, uninstalling the app or resetting app data can affect access. Exports are separate copies, not an automatic cloud backup. Keep a separate copy of information you need.

Optional Pupwell Plus

The app will show the available features, complete price, billing period, renewal terms and any eligible trial before purchase. Subscriptions are managed through your App Store account. Deleting the app does not cancel a subscription. Both people currently need their own Plus membership to use a Friends connection.

Our artwork

The Pupwell name, artwork and website materials are provided to explain the product. Please do not present them as your own product or imply an endorsement. Font licenses are included with the website assets.

Subscriptions and Apple agreement

Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled through your Apple account. An annual price shown as a monthly equivalent is billed as a yearly payment. A trial applies only when offered by the App Store and you are eligible; the displayed recurring charge applies after it ends unless you cancel in time. Deleting your online account or ending a Friends connection does not cancel a subscription. Saved voice recordings stay accessible if Plus ends. Use Restore purchases to check store access.

The iOS app is licensed under Apple's Standard End User License Agreement. Manage or cancel a subscription or request a refund through Apple.

Contact and your rights

For support, reports or questions about these terms, email hello@trypupwell.app. You can remove a sent note, stop sharing, disconnect or block in Friends. These terms do not limit consumer rights that apply to you.

Read the privacy information or visit Support.
